metadata.note: Alternating native full in-memory builds at quality80, default no Zopfli, manifest enabled. Warmup repetition0 excluded; median of two whole-corpus totals. Includes SVG validation, placement, render and encoding; excludes imports, source reads, independent references, post-build scoring and file writes. ICO source error against unoptimized source at its own resolution; encoding error against raw selected-SVG pixels. All non-ICO files asserted byte-identical across arms; all files deterministic across repetitions. No browser timing, downsampling quality or all-size 1% guarantee.
